note: Edition rows were checked against a publisher or product page and are kept ahead of any older dataset. Dataset rows are exact BoardGameGeek id matches from public snapshots; the year is a snapshot label, not a promise the count is current. Expansion rows need the base game. Hot Streak is open-ended, 2–9+, and has no numeric maximum. Counts of 99 and unresolved conflicts were not imported. Durations are not included.
